title: Growl trumpet and mutes: derby, glass and bottle; Chris Kelly
summary: Cootie growled by hand, derby or glass; Sayles and a trumpeter visitor swap talk of aluminium mutes, Chris Kelly's blues on a derby, and improvised mutes.
